rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a collection of literary works, especially selected works by different authors.

example.english: This anthology includes fine works by different poets.
example.traditional: 呢本選集收錄咗唔同詩人嘅佳作。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 syun2 zaap6 sau1 luk6 zo2 m4 tung4 si1 jan4 ge3 gaai1 zok3

rows.note: Use this when the anthology is specifically a book or series of unrelated stories.

example.english: The stories in this anthology are unrelated, but quite enjoyable.
example.traditional: 呢本故事集入面啲故事互不相干，但幾好睇。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 gu3 si6 zaap6 jap6 min6 di1 gu3 si6 wu6 bat1 soeng1 gon1 daan6 gei2 hou2 tai2
